authorization_basis: Approved independent AUTH-V11 implementation scope and direct user instruction to proceed; Docker availability confirmed by user.
implemented: Single PostgreSQL SERIALIZABLE transaction combining sleeve evaluation, sticky latch, reservation and diagnostic event
Aggregate row lock and bounded retry on serialization/deadlock failure
Per-symbol and gross ledger commitments included conservatively in sleeve risk
Missing/inconsistent state rejection and failed-update rollback

qualification.container_cleanup: Removed disposable test container; existing app/db containers unchanged

not_implemented: Trusted marked prices and account/cash reconciliation
Authenticated baseline/day/reset lifecycle and operational owners
Whole-account hard stops and portfolio exposure decisions
Dynamic cash/exposure adjustment and real fills
limitations: Synthetic fixed one-account/sleeve budgets; no actual funding confirmation
Conservative retained acquisition costs including fees stand in for ledger marked exposure; no market revaluation qualification
Input external baseline commitments must exclude ledger-managed commitments
Explicit synthetic terminal verification is not broker evidence
State JSON validates structure/budget invariants, not immutable or tamper-proof audit; database owner may edit state
Bounded contention testing is not production load/crash recovery qualification
Existing loss/reservation SQLite artifacts are not migrated; integrated PostgreSQL scope is initialized independently
